title: Checklist
summary: A frosted-glass checklist card whose steps type in and tick off as they are said.
description: A dark frosted-glass card with a tracked header (ALL YOU NEED TO DO), an 'N of 3' counter and a segmented yellow progress bar. Each step types itself in when it is spoken, then its circle fills yellow with a check and a little burst, the counter ticks up and its bar segment fills. The card places itself above the speaker's head when there is room, otherwise over the chest, and moves the captions out of its way.

options.title: small header text on the card
options.items: "auto" (3 short steps pulled from the transcript) or a list. Each item is a string, or {"text": "Drop your clips", "at": "@drop", "doneAt": "@trigger"}. "at" = when it types in (default: when its first key word is spoken), "doneAt" = when it ticks (default: checkAfter seconds after typing finishes).
options.count: how many items to generate when items is "auto"
options.inAt: when the card appears (seconds or "@word"); it always appears a moment before the first item
options.outAt: optional: when the card flies away (null = stays to the end)
options.checkAfter: seconds between an item finishing typing and its tick
options.typeSpeed: typing speed in characters per second
options.position: "auto" (above the head if there is room, else over the chest), "top", "bottom", or a 0-1 fraction for the card's top edge
options.width: card width as a fraction of the frame width
options.accent: colour of the ticks, progress bar and glow
options.tilt: 3D tilt of the card in degrees (0 = flat)
options.captionsAvoid: move the captions above/below the card if they would overlap it
